issues.description: Missing `import sys` in cpython/mathimpl.py and np/math/mathimpl.py where new version guards reference sys.version_info
issues.detail: Both impl files add `if sys.version_info >= (3, 11):` guards but the diff shows no `import sys` added to either. If sys isn't already imported at module top, this raises NameError at import time on every Python version, breaking numba entirely. Verify and add the import before merge.

issues.description: Math_unary registration placement in mathdecl.py breaks class scope readability and indentation
issues.detail: The `if sys.version_info >= (3, 11):` block is inserted immediately after the Math_unary class body with the separating blank line removed. The control flow may be correct but the placement complects class definition with conditional registration and is hard to read. Restore separation, add a comment, and respect the file's two-blank-line convention.

issues.description: Test x_values copy-pasted from test_exp don't exercise exp2's distinguishing base-2 semantics
issues.detail: `x_values = [-2, -1, -2, 2, 1, 2, .1, .2]` is reused verbatim from test_exp, including a duplicated -2. exp2 has exact integer answers at integer inputs (exp2(10)=1024, exp2(-2)=0.25) that would catch a wrong intrinsic binding to llvm.exp. Add values where exp and exp2 disagree sharply.

issues.description: Version-gate idiom is inconsistent and duplicated across four files
issues.detail: The test uses `PYVERSION >= (3, 11)` from numba.core.utils while mathdecl.py and both mathimpl.py files use raw `sys.version_info`. One fact (does this Python expose math.exp2) is scattered as four conditionals in two different idioms. Use PYVERSION everywhere, or centralize as a single `_HAS_MATH_EXP2` capability flag.

issues.description: Release note file missing trailing newline
issues.detail: `docs/upcoming_changes/10276.new_feature.rst` ends with `\ No newline at end of file`. POSIX text files should terminate with `\n`; some RST toolchains and linters flag this. Trivial fix every reviewer will flag — handle it before resubmit.

issues.description: Release note title underline is exactly title-length and risks RST warnings
issues.detail: The title `Add support for ``math.exp2``.` is 31 chars but the underline is 30 dashes. Depending on how RST counts backticks this may warn or fail to render. The note body also tautologically restates the title; replace with a user-facing fact about nopython support semantics.

synthesis.summary: The PR shape is right — decl + two impls + test + docs + release note — and math.exp2 maps cleanly onto the existing unary_math_intr machinery via llvm.exp2. But it would not land as-is. Two impl files reference sys.version_info without showing an `import sys`, suggesting the patch wasn't built on a clean checkout. Version-gating uses two different idioms (raw sys.version_info vs PYVERSION) duplicated across four files for a single fact. The test copy-pastes exp's inputs and doesn't validate base-2 semantics. NEEDS-WORK: fix imports, normalize version checks via PYVERSION, give exp2 distinguishing test values, and fix the release note.
